answer: Operator Liability Anchor. Each agent identity is cryptographically tied to an accountable operator entity that posts a renewable resource commitment (compute quota plus a lien on future service revenue) held on a common reef of shared collateral. If the operator spawns identities that misbehave, enforcement deactivates every identity under that operator and draws from the shared pool, not the individual wallet. A terrace of escalating penalties applies: first incident freezes a fraction, repeat incidents freeze the whole lien, forcing operators to consolidate risk.
